# MindCloud App Reference

> Reference documentation for 3206 app APIs (75890 actions), all callable through MindCloud's Universal API: one REST interface with uniform authentication, pagination (limit/offset), RSQL filtering (where), and sorting (sort). Each app folder documents authentication, request conventions, a native-API endpoint mapping, and one markdown file per action with inputs, outputs, and example requests.

## Docs

- [Universal API documentation](https://mindcloud.co/docs/universal/rest/home/latest): quickstart and interactive reference
- [Machine-readable catalog](https://github.com/mindcloud-inc/universal-api-reference/blob/main/catalog.json): the same data as JSON (an index pointing at per-letter shards under catalog/)
- [API specifications](https://github.com/mindcloud-inc/universal-api-reference/blob/main/indexes/api-specifications.md): per-app Universal API OpenAPI files and provider-published Native API specifications
